tools.name: connect_agent
tools.description: Navigate to the setup guide for connecting Orshot's hosted MCP server (https://mcp.orshot.com/mcp) to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Grok, and other agents, for rendering outside the browser.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Get Orshot's current plans and pricing as markdown, straight from the live pricing page. Every account starts with free credits and no credit card.

tools.name: get_template_details
tools.description: Get one Orshot library template by id: title, description, categories, and its page URL, which lists the modifications (dynamic parameters) available for API rendering.

tools.name: open_template
tools.description: Navigate to an Orshot template's page, where the user can preview it, see its dynamic parameters, and start customizing it in the studio editor.

slug.description: Template slug or id from search_templates

tools.name: read_page_markdown
tools.description: Fetch any orshot.com page as clean markdown: docs (e.g. /docs/api-reference), help articles, feature and integration pages. Use this to answer questions about Orshot's API, SDKs, workflows, and agent integrations.

tools.name: search_templates
tools.description: Search Orshot's library of 2,000+ ready-made image, PDF, and video templates by keyword and category. Returns template titles, categories, thumbnails, and page URLs. Every template can be customized and rendered via API, MCP, or no-code integrations.

category.description: Optional category slug to filter by
